question.text: Category III AIFs must undertake AT LEAST what percentage of their total monthly secondary-market trades in Corporate Bonds through the RFQ platform?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 118 of the workbook, Category III AIFs must undertake at least 10% of their total monthly secondary-market corporate bond trades by placing or seeking quotes on the RFQ platform. The Trap: 5% is below the prescribed minimum, and 25%/50% are not the prescribed thresholds. Note: 10% is a minimum routing requirement; funds remain free to execute the balance of their bond trades through other permitted channels.
